title: Crypto traders price India telecoms company Reliance Jio's IPO at about $110 billion
summary: The pre-IPO Jio contract on Bitget is trading near $12, a roughly 4% premium on the top price band, as India’s largest public offering remains open for subscription.

title: Live updates: Bitcoin’s round trip to $85,000 burns traders on both sides
summary: Bitcoin gave back its run at $85,000 and broke below $82,500 as weak tech earnings soured the mood. XMR bucked the drop with an 11% jump.

title: Asian stocks tumble, bitcoin retreats as China enters bear market
summary: Technology shares led regional losses as mixed U.S. earnings unsettled investors and Brent crude climbed above $112 a barrel.

title: China seeks to seize 61,800 BTC tied to $5.7 billion fraud scheme
summary: Chinese prosecutors are seeking to confiscate more than 61,800 Bitcoin tied to a $5.7 billion fraud scheme, days after a U.K. court ruled Chinese law governs victims’ claims to the coins.

title: Solana’s biggest network change since 2020 is live. Here’s how users benefit
summary: The new voting system targets settlement in about 150 milliseconds, potentially shortening waits for payments and deposits. Users can keep their existing wallets.
